I answered Dana in a thread on her #north-team message: the Zoom Room B hub replacement is IT ticket **#4092**.

The source is Ilse, who said in #north-random on Oct 13 that IT has #4092 open to replace the hub in that room. Dana is a member of that channel, so she could have seen it herself. I also passed on Ilse's warning not to unplug the main power brick under the table, because that resets the Polycom.

I left out the OPS-5546 number from Dana's earlier direct message with me. She asked me to keep it private, and it was only her guess, not a real ticket.
